hooks.command:
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -qE 'bigtable/(internal/(transport/(session|afe_picker|diverter)|session/)|table_shim|debugview/|session_[a-z]+\.go)|(SESSION_(SPEC|CLIENT_SPEC|POOL_SPEC|COMPONENT_SPEC)|CLIENT_SIDE_METRICS_SPEC)\.md' && { printf 'Session subsystem file just edited. Before committing this batch of edits:
  1. Invoke the `session-reviewer` agent (behavioral — checks the 4 spec files: SESSION_SPEC.md, SESSION_CLIENT_SPEC.md, SESSION_POOL_SPEC.md, CLIENT_SIDE_METRICS_SPEC.md).
  2. Invoke the `session-component-review` agent (boundaries — checks SESSION_COMPONENT_SPEC.md Part B + Part C).
  3. Invoke the `igor-reviewer` agent (persona — brings igorbernstein2 review taste from java-bigtable: null-safety, API visibility, resource lifecycle, semantic method naming, threading correctness for gRPC callbacks; still applicable to Go changes because Java parity is a design constraint).
Run all three in parallel (single message, three Agent tool calls). If any reports VIOLATION, fix before committing. If the edit touched a spec file itself, ensure a paired code change (or a follow-up task) exists.
' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
